title: Dynamic Database Resolution & Transaction Context Integration
summary: Completed final audit and gap refactoring for Dynamic Database Resolution and Transaction Context Consistency across all operational repositories.
changes: Refactored 13 Dexie repositories to dynamically resolve the database instance using the (this.table as any).db || localDb pattern.
Updated all local transaction blocks to run on the dynamically resolved dbInstance to support testing and isolated sandbox contexts without PrematureCommitError or TransactionInactiveError.

Passed the dynamically resolved dbInstance inside the option parameter of syncRepository.enqueue ({ db: dbInstance }) to enforce transactional consistency across the operational database and Sync Queue.
preventions: Guaranteed transaction context alignment where transactionDb === repositoryDb === syncDb.
nextStep: All repositories verified and successfully compiled.
